play.comments:
3 players (Meire, Nicole e Sandro)
Primeiro jogo da série Exit para conhecer. Mais difícil do que eu esperava. Nicole acabou desistindo. Meire gostou bastante. Conforme vai ficando cansativo, apelamos com mais frequência para as pistas. A pista 1 nunca traz uma dica relevante (sempre é algo que já descobrimos) mas com a pista 2 é possível descobrir o enigma. Vou tentar outros da série mas apenas para jogar com a Meire.

play.comments:
4-player game
Total game time: 2 hours
Summer felt this game was so boring she never helped out once.
I actually thought the clues were unsolvable as presented so I kinda quit halfway through it and just talked to Summer about dogs.
Rogie and Wifey muddled through together for the last hour and finally solved it. They needed to use four clues to solve this game which means four times they got stuck and couldn't figure out how to proceed.
We did not like this game. This was our second game in the series. I think we're done with this series.
